model: Open finite free-fermion hopping chain with two centered onsite potentials, initial staggered mass 2.5.
convention: Discrete normalized Gaussian σ=2 on fixed interval to .75L/.76L, dt=0.05, prominence 0.08.
caviar: Both defect orientations are mirror-related. The bound-free control changes the initial state, which is no longer the original local staggered-mass ground state. The crossover is smoothing dependent. This is NOT a proven new phase-only physics law.
